recognize_zh: 臨床照片中大腿近膝處有一個橢圓形瘀斑（ecchymosis），中央轉為黃綠色、外圍呈紫褐色，表示不同時期的皮下出血吸收中；皮膚未見壞死或隆起，屬血小板低下常見的皮膚出血表現但不具特異性。
features: Oval ecchymosis on the anterior thigh above the knee
Central yellow-green discoloration with a purple-brown periphery indicating resolving hemorrhage
Flat, non-palpable lesion without necrosis or ulceration
Faint additional bruising near the knee
No petechiae clearly resolved at this photographic resolution
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a flat, oval ecchymosis on the anterior thigh with a yellow-green center and purple-brown rim, indicating resolving subcutaneous hemorrhage, with faint additional bruising near the knee. There is no skin necrosis, palpable purpura, or hematoma swelling. Mucocutaneous bleeding of this type is compatible with immune thrombocytopenia, but the finding is nonspecific; a complete blood count with smear review is required to document isolated thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Ordinary bruising occurs with normal platelet count and coagulation studies; only laboratory testing separates it.

ddx.dx: Von Willebrand disease or other platelet function disorder
ddx.vs: Bruising is similar but platelet count is normal with abnormal VWF studies or platelet function testing.
Thrombocytopenia is accompanied by anemia, abnormal white count or circulating blasts on the smear.
Suggested by patterned bruises in unusual locations with inconsistent history and normal hemostatic testing.
